name: websearch-to-exa
description: Overrides the built-in WebSearch tool and routes queries to the Exa search API through $.http.fetch, answering in WebSearch's own result shape, with automatic fallback to the built-in search. A tool.call hook that replaces a core tool.

exaApiKey.title: Exa API key
exaApiKey.description: Your Exa API key; with none set, the built-in WebSearch runs

numResults.title: Results per query
numResults.description: How many Exa results to return
